label.purpose: Section eyebrows, stat labels, mentor tag.

body-ar.purpose: Paragraph copy in Arabic, taller line-height than English.

motion.name: cta-shimmer
motion.purpose: Diagonal light sweep across every primary CTA button, running continuously.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid gold CTA with a continuous diagonal shimmer sweep. The system's only button style.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; background: #D4AF37; color: #000; border: none; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 44px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; font-family: inherit; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 0%, transparent 60%); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0.55) 50%, transparent 60%); background-size: 250% 100%; background-position: 150% 0; animation: ds-cta-shimmer 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-btn-sub { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.65; margin-top: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } @keyframes ds-cta-shimmer { 0%, 35% { background-position: 150% 0; } 65%, 100% { background-position: -50% 0; } }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Proof-metric card: bold gold number over a small gray label. Used for years experience, students trained, payouts, funded capital.
components.css: .ds-mstat { background: linear-gradient(155deg, #171717 0%, #0d0d0d 55%, #0a0a0a 100%); border: 1px solid #1e1e1e; border-radius: 4px; padding: 12px 16px; text-align: center; } .ds-mstat-num { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; color: #D4AF37; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } .ds-mstat-lbl { font-size: 10px; color: #777; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow Label
components.description: Plain-text gold eyebrow above every section headline. No background chip -- an earlier bordered-pill treatment was deliberately removed.
components.css: .ds-section-label { display: inline-block; color: #D4AF37; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 16px; }

components.name: Gold-Word Headline
components.description: The system's signature headline pattern: a plain phrase followed by one gold word. Used on nearly every section h2.
components.css: .ds-headline { font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 42px); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: -1px; line-height: 1.1; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; } .ds-g { color: #D4AF37; }

components.name: Certificate Scroll Row
components.description: Signature component: horizontal-scrolling row of small certificate/proof thumbnails with a thin custom gold scrollbar, click to open a lightbox.
components.css: .ds-cert-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 10px; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.3) transparent; } .ds-cert-row::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 4px; } .ds-cert-row::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(212,175,55,0.3); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-cert-thumb { height: 92px; width: auto; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #1e1e1e; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-cert-thumb:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.4); }

narrative.overview: The whole system reads as a live trading terminal at rest: a near-void black session backdrop with one moving, glowing element -- gold -- that stands in for the market itself. The live candlestick chart behind the hero isn't decoration bolted onto a marketing page; it's the thesis of the design made literal. Everything else (typography, cards, dividers) borrows the same restraint: dark, quiet, and confident, with gold reserved for the things that matter. The palette is fixed by brand commitment -- gold and black are not a starting point to explore away from. A full palette swap (e.g. to white/blue) was explicitly considered and rejected: it read as generic fintech instead of 'elite trader.'
keyCharacteristics: Near-void black backdrop with a single gold accent used sparingly and purposefully
Two headline fonts doing two different jobs: Montserrat (English) vs. Cairo (Arabic) -- never the same family serving both
A gold divider line with a soft radial glow marks every section boundary, standing in for shadows
Motion is restrained and purposeful: CTA shimmer, fade-up reveals, a live candlestick chart -- never decorative for its own sake

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only color allowed to draw the eye. If something new needs emphasis, it either becomes gold or it doesn't get emphasis.

rules.name: The Chart Exception
rules.body: The live candlestick chart uses its own literal market green/red instead of the site's gold/red pair, scoped only to that component.

rules.name: The Gold Word Rule
rules.body: Nearly every headline is a plain phrase plus one gold-colored final word (the .g class). New headlines should default to this pattern.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never use box-shadow for elevation. Use a tonal step (Session Black to Card Charcoal to Card Charcoal Bright) or a gold radial glow instead.

dos: Do keep gold reserved for emphasis -- if it appears more than roughly once per view, it's stopped being an accent.
Do write Arabic and English as two independent, natural texts sharing one meaning -- never transliterate or code-switch.
Do use the gold-word headline pattern as the default emphasis technique for new headlines.
Do use a tonal step or gold radial glow for depth, per the No-Shadow Rule.
Do keep radius at 4px for new rectangular surfaces unless matching the 6px large-surface exception.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color anywhere outside the live chart's literal market green/red.
Don't bring back a background-and-border chip treatment on eyebrow labels -- that was tried and removed for looking like generic AI-template design.
Don't fabricate proof (testimonials, results, names) -- a previous fabricated-testimonials section was removed and must not be reintroduced casually.
